speaker: RAINORAY
text: Rain. Cold stone. I was in the supply room a moment ago.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: One more count before dawn. That's what I kept telling myself.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: No hands. No boots. I seem to have kept the exhaustion.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: There's a lamp beyond the ditch. Please let someone be holding it.

speaker: MARA
text: Easy. The last thing that crawled out of that ditch tried to eat my boots.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: I'll try to be a better guest. I'm Rainoray. Quartermaster.

speaker: MARA
text: Rainoray? Your supplies reached us. You never did.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: I'm having some trouble accounting for myself. Where is everyone?

speaker: MARA
text: We sent the wounded east. Then the rift struck the gatehouse. The Warden turned on the road it was guarding.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: And you stayed?

speaker: MARA
text: Someone has to be here if they come back. I'm Mara.

speaker: MARA
text: Follow the torn banners east to Muster Ground. The road runs on through Inner Court to the gate.

speaker: MARA
text: Someone called from the storehouse south of that road. You might fit under its fence.

speaker: MARA
text: The dead still draw back before they strike. Step aside, then answer.

speaker: MARA
text: East past the banners, then north at Inner Court. The signal tower lies north of camp if you need bearings.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: East, then north. I used to mark those supply routes myself.

speaker: MARA
text: Rest to steady your Ichor. Leave supplies here or at a lit brazier; we'll gather them.

speaker: MARA
text: The gate's quiet. Was that your doing?

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Rainoray. Quartermaster. I was looking for a way out.

speaker: MARA
text: You're the name on our supply slips? I'm Mara. I kept a bed for you.

speaker: MARA
text: We sent the wounded east before the Warden turned. I tried to follow, but the roots had closed the forest road.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Then that's where I'll look next.

speaker: MARA
text: Come back if you find them. Come back if you don't, too.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: A dispatch, folded under the bell rope. 'Hold the east road until the last stretcher passes.'

speaker: RAINORAY
text: No death count. Just names marked missing. Mine is here, too.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Someone crossed it out, then wrote it back in. Mara should see this.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Someone crossed it out, then wrote it back in. Someone wasn't sure.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Every bed was stripped for bandages. Except this one.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: A note on the blanket: 'For whoever comes back.'

speaker: RAINORAY
text: There's a dry dressing underneath. I'll leave it where she can find it.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: My seal. These are the crates I stayed to count.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: 'Blankets on top. Leave the weapons if the cart is too heavy.' My handwriting, too.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: The blankets are gone. Good. At least that part worked.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: I found the evacuation list. You crossed out my name.

speaker: MARA
text: I thought I'd seen you fall. Then I thought of how far away I was.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: So you wrote it back in.

speaker: MARA
text: Yes. I'm glad I did.

speaker: WARDEN
text: HALT. THE LAST STRETCHER HAS NOT PASSED.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: They're gone. Mara's the only one left. Open the gate.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: There's no stretcher on this road. Let me through. Someone may still need help.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: People are still coming back. You're blocking their way. Open the gate.

speaker: WARDEN
text: ICHOR DETECTED. YOU ARE NOT ON THE EVACUATION LIST.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Rainoray. Quartermaster. You watched me bring those supplies in.

speaker: WARDEN
text: QUARTERMASTER: DECEASED. HOLD THE ROAD.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Then you'll have to stop me twice.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: The chain is broken. Stretcher tracks run through the gate and into the trees.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Only one set of footprints comes back. Mara's.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Only one set of footprints comes back toward camp.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: The others got this far. I can follow them.

speaker: MARA
text: The gate's quiet.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: It's open. I'm going after the stretcher tracks.

speaker: MARA
text: I tried. The roots have swallowed the road. There's a dry scarf by the fire; take it before you go.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: I'm not sure it would stay on.

speaker: MARA
text: Then I'll keep it dry.

speaker: TOBIN
text: Who's there? If you're a rift thing, I'm mostly bandages. Poor eating.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Rainoray. Quartermaster. Mostly water, these days.

speaker: TOBIN
text: The quartermaster? We carried your crates out and left your name on the list.

speaker: TOBIN
text: The fence came down behind me. I couldn't climb it, and nothing friendly fits under.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Mara's lamp is still lit at Captain Camp. Can you make it that far?

speaker: RAINORAY
text: There's a lamp by the captain's tent. Head there. Someone is keeping it lit.

speaker: TOBIN
text: For a lamp? I'll crawl. Thank you.

speaker: ILSE
text: Stay back. I've got one good arm and I'm not afraid to use it.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Rainoray. Quartermaster. I cut the thorns, not you.

speaker: ILSE
text: Ilse. Signals. I hid in here when the brambles came up. They grew faster than I could cut.

speaker: ILSE
text: That chest is the quartermaster's cache. Locked tight, and the key went with the storehouse.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Then it's still my job. Go to Mara's lamp at Captain Camp.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: There's a lamp by the captain's tent. Head there. Someone is keeping it lit.

speaker: ILSE
text: If anyone can find one small key in this mess, it's the man who counted every nail.

speaker: VENN
text: Took them long enough to send someone. I pictured someone taller.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Nobody sent me. I'm afraid I'm just late.

speaker: VENN
text: Venn. Sergeant, once. I told the stretcher crew to go on without me.

speaker: VENN
text: Then the culvert silted up and I spent a week talking to the rain.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Mara is keeping a fire at Captain Camp. She has room for you.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: There's a lamp by the captain's tent. Head there. Someone is keeping it lit.

speaker: VENN
text: Mara. Good. Then I'll go and be shouted at properly.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: The cache opens. Bandages, a little coin, and my ledger.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Every crate, every blanket, every name that signed for them.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Tobin, Ilse, Venn. All signed the same morning. I'll see that the count comes out right.

speaker: MARA
text: Someone walked into my camp tonight and asked for you by name.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: They were still out there, waiting. I couldn't leave them.

speaker: MARA
text: Then keep looking. The dispatch listed more people than the Warden let through.

speaker: MARA
text: Tobin, Ilse and Venn. Three beds that aren't empty anymore.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: The count finally adds up. Better than I'd hoped.

speaker: MARA
text: Ilse found the last of the good tea. Take the coin we were saving with it. You've earned both.

speaker: MARA
text: Keep to the road. I'll keep the lamp lit.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Was that a voice? South of the road.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: Confirmed. Someone is still alive.
provenance: Original approved discovery takes: polish-settings.json / english-audition-lines.json. Metrics use runtime WAV rather than raw MP3.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Then we're not leaving them here.
provenance: Original approved discovery takes: polish-settings.json / english-audition-lines.json. Metrics use runtime WAV rather than raw MP3.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: One name off the missing list. Keep looking.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: That was not on the supply list.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: I have started a separate list.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Let's listen before we move.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: Agreed. The road carries sound.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: This road used to mean safe passage.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: It can again. That is why we continue.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: I preferred counting things.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: You still count who gets home.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Do I get a quieter job after this?

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: You have not finished this one.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Someone taught them to hold this road.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: The order survived its purpose.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: One moment. I'll check behind us.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: A sensible habit. Keep it.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Funny. I didn't stop shaking.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: You moved anyway.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: I don't want to get used to that.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: Then remember why you are here.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Forward, then. One problem at a time.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: One step is enough for now.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Are you keeping count too?

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: Only of the decisions that matter.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Give me a moment before we go.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: Take it. Rushing is not recovery.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: That was closer than I'd planned.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: Find shelter before another fight.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: All right. A little less bravery.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: A little more distance would help.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: I could use that campfire now.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: A retreat can still be progress.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Tell me that looked deliberate.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: I would prefer to be accurate.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: I used to know every turn here.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: Then we can learn what has changed.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: I keep reaching for a bag I lost.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: Old habits are slow to catch up.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Do my questions ever tire you?

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: Not yet. You may continue.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: You can talk without being asked.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: I was leaving room for your thoughts.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Was it always this quiet here?

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: You remember people. That is different.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Who is still waiting out there?

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: Someone may be asking that about you.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Sage. That name suits you.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: It is sufficient. I will answer to it.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: A map never shows how a place feels.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: Someone must carry that part.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: If I sound calm, don't be fooled.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: I hear more than your tone.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: I used to worry about missing nails.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: You noticed what others overlooked.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: She really is keeping that lamp lit.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: She is making a place to return to.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: She spoke to me like I was a person.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: You still are.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: I didn't expect to miss ordinary talk.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: You do not have to stop having it.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: I wish I could promise her more.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: Return when you can. Start with that.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: Watch its windup. Then move.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: I only need one opening.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: More power. Less control.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Good. I'll use that.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: Fall back. You need room.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: The road's open.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: And you are still here.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: Ground slam.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: Wide sweep.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: Charge.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: Shockwave.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: Rift strike.
